description: Witness for k = 48 on the support displayed in Stadlmann, 'Bounded gaps between primes' (arXiv:2608.31126v1): eps = 0.0075, A = 0.253, delta = 0.028, caps 0.15, 0.15, 0.17. F~(x) = sum c * (L - |x|_1)^a * m_alpha(x), m_alpha the monomial symmetric polynomial in K variables, on T~ = {|x|_1 <= L, sum of coordinates > g is <= C(number of such coordinates)}, in the dilated coordinates x = scale * t (scale = (26/25)/(A + eps)); the marginal runs over sums <= tau. In the physical scale K*J/I = K*J(F~)/(scale*I(F~)); the criterion is that this exceeds 1.
